text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"It's finally here! The destination El first set her eyes on,
my dream, and the gateway to the world!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
It's the Japan Cuuuup!
Hello to all my fans—¡Hola!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOO!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Huh, El Condor Pasa!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Cutting right through the middle of the fans on purpose?
Classic you! That's so hype!!

El Condor Pasa never forgets her showmanship.
She makes her way down the path lined with fans, high-fiving them as she goes.

"Acknowledging the cheers pouring in from both sides,
we first head to the track for an inspection."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Trainer, standing in this place right now, I finally understand.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Why El wasn't able to come here
during her Classic year?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"I was lacking in so many things. Skill,
confidence, and the sense of duty to entertain everyone."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Still, right now—!
choice_data_list: Yeah, you're not outclassed at all!
Yeah, we're not outclassed at all!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...¡Bueno! That is correct.
I am the one truly worthy of this stage.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
A dream delayed by a whole lap... But for being one lap behind,
I'll show you I can win a million times more valiantly, yes!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
El-chan, it's just like that Derby, isn't it?
Tokyo, 2400 meters...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: "But maybe today... I can...!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course it is fun desu!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: El and Spe-chan have both gotten so much stronger, and we've gained so many fans, desu!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Back then, we said we'd make it an amazing race, but...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I wanna run an even more amazing race today! And then
beat El-chan and become the best in Japan!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Me too!! I am so happy
to run with a Spe-chan who has gotten this strong, yeees!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Let's make this a match race between the two of us!
Spe-chan, you truly are
my "Japan Cup"!
